text: Fix 4 problems to close, or ask a manager to override
Try a game we sell already
Load a pack into a box
Sell 1 ticket Same as scanning ticket #005
Mark sold out Last ticket is gone — count the rest as sold
Switch boxes Swap places with another box
Change box number Move this pack to an empty box
Fix ticket number Manager Count is off? Set the next ticket #
Return or store pack Send back to Lottery, or keep in the safe
Loaded by mistake Manager Clear the box. No sales are recorded
Cancel — keep it in the box
🧹 Trim Extra Empty Boxes Remove empty trailing boxes from the counter rack (down to 20 or highest used box). All loaded lottery packs remain intact.
💵 Reset Shift Sales to $0.00 Set current ticket positions as new opening numbers so shift sales reset to $0.00 without removing any lottery games.
🔄 Refresh System & Clear Scanner Clear any stuck barcode input, dismiss error banners, and resync counter state.
🗑️ Full Data Reset (Clean Slate) Wipe all POS sales, custom boxes, and shifts for a fresh start. (Requires confirmation)
